shortDescription: This module manages IP partnerships on IBM Storage Virtualize family systems

options.name: backgroundcopyrate
options.description: Specifies the maximum percentage of aggregate link bandwidth that can be used for background copy operations. This is a numeric value from 0 through 100. The default value is 50. Valid when I(state=present).

options.name: clustername
options.description: The hostname or management IP of the Storage Virtualize system.

options.name: compressed
options.description: Specifies whether compression is enabled for this partnership. C(compressed=yes) is not supported on FS5060, FS5600, FS7600, FS9600 platforms. Valid when I(state=present).

options.name: domain
options.description: Domain for the Storage Virtualize system. Valid when hostname is used for the parameter I(clustername).

options.name: link1
options.description: Specifies the portset name to be used for WAN link 1 of the Storage Virtualize system. Valid when I(state=present), to create an IP partnership.

options.name: link2
options.description: Specifies the portset name to be used for WAN link 2 of the Storage Virtualize system. Valid when I(state=present), to create an IP partnership.

options.name: linkbandwidthmbits
options.description: Specifies the aggregate bandwidth of the RC link between two clustered systems (systems) in megabits per second (Mbps). This is a numeric value from 1 through 100000. Valid when I(state=present).

options.name: log_path
options.description: Path of debug log file.

options.name: password
options.description: REST API password for the Storage Virtualize system. The parameters I(username) and I(password) are required if not using I(token) to authenticate a user.

options.name: pbrinuse
options.description: Specifies whether policy-based replication will be used on the partnership. Valid when I(state=present) to update a partnership.

options.name: remote_cluster_id
options.description: Specifies the partnership ID of the partner system. Required when I(state=present), to modify an existing IP partnership. Required when I(state=absent), to remove an existing IP partnership.

options.name: remote_clusterip
options.description: Specifies the partner system IP address, either IPv4 or IPv6. Required when I(state=present), to create an IP partnership.

options.name: remote_clustername
options.description: The hostname or management IP of the remote Storage Virtualize system.

options.name: remote_domain
options.description: Domain for the remote Storage Virtualize system. Valid when hostname is used for the parameter I(remote_clustername).

options.name: remote_link1
options.description: Specifies the portset name to be used for WAN link 1 of the remote Storage Virtualize system. Valid when I(state=present), to create an IP partnership.

options.name: remote_link2
options.description: Specifies the portset name to be used for WAN link 2 of the remote Storage Virtualize system. Valid when I(state=present), to create an IP partnership.

options.name: remote_password
options.description: REST API password for the remote Storage Virtualize system. The parameters I(remote_username) and I(remote_password) are required if not using I(remote_token) to authenticate a user.

options.name: remote_token
options.description: The authentication token to verify a user on the remote Storage Virtualize system. To generate a token, use the M(ibm.storage_virtualize.ibm_svc_auth) module.

options.name: remote_username
options.description: REST API username for the remote Storage Virtualize system. The parameters I(remote_username) and I(remote_password) are required if not using I(remote_token) to authenticate a user.

options.name: remote_validate_certs
options.description: Validates certification for the remote Storage Virtualize system.

options.name: state
options.description: Creates or updates (C(present)) or removes (C(absent)) an IP partnership.

options.name: token
options.description: The authentication token to verify a user on the Storage Virtualize system. To generate a token, use the M(ibm.storage_virtualize.ibm_svc_auth) module.

options.name: type
options.description: Specifies the Internet Protocol (IP) address format for the partnership. Valid when I(state=present).

options.name: username
options.description: REST API username for the Storage Virtualize system. The parameters I(username) and I(password) are required if not using I(token) to authenticate a user.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Validates certification for the local Storage Virtualize system.
